How the scoring works

For the home team, projected spread advantage is projected home margin plus its official spread. A selected side wins against the spread when its final adjusted margin is positive, pushes when it is zero, and loses when negative. Circa points are 1, 0.5 and 0 respectively. Win percentage excludes pushes. Missing predictions are not losses. Expected points require a documented cover-and-push distribution with the correct official line and source clocks.

Margin-only diagnostic ranking is explicitly provisional. It does not create calibrated cover probabilities or expected points. Manual picks do not alter model forecasts, frozen cards, historical scores, calibration, or actual entry records. No order or contest submission is made by this page.
